0022600023.text: The Lakers, now 4-1 and first in the Pacific, visit the 2-3 Golden State Warriors, who sit 10th in the West and two games back of the Lakers in their division, and the Lakers are on a one-game winning streak while the Warriors are riding two straight wins. The Lakers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 127-105 win in Los Angeles on October 21, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1. Los Angeles will be without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain), while Luka Doncic (back) and Ziaire Williams (foot) are day-to-day and game-time decisions; Golden State will be without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
